summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries and rounds to 2 decimals with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero (RQ-FXL-0003, DF-FXL-0007). Unapproved and other-tenant entries are excluded.

criteria.criterion: Approved 0.005 alone totals 0.01; approved -0.005 alone totals -0.01.
criteria.test: total rounds approved amounts half away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count.
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved entries and other tenants

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve per RQ-FXL-0004. Checks run in order: isActive (SessionExpired), hasRole Approver (NotAuthorized), entry lookup in the session's tenant (NotFound), self-approval (SelfApproval), already approved (AlreadyApproved). On success it sets Approved = true and ApprovedBy = Some session.UserId and changes nothing else. Session logic uses FxIdentity.Identity.isActive and hasRole.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve.
criteria.test: approve accepts a session idle for exactly 15 minutes

criteria.criterion: At 15 minutes 1 second the session gets SessionExpired.
criteria.test: approve rejects a session idle for 15 minutes and 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized.
criteria.test: admin without approver role is not authorized to approve

criteria.criterion: An entry of another tenant is reported as NotFound, never NotAuthorized.
criteria.test: approving an entry of another tenant reports NotFound

criteria.criterion: An approver cannot approve an entry they created (SelfApproval).
criteria.test: approver cannot approve their own entry

criteria.criterion: Approving an already approved entry gives AlreadyApproved.
criteria.test: approving an already approved entry reports AlreadyApproved

criteria.criterion: On success the entry gets Approved = true and ApprovedBy = Some session.UserId, with nothing else changed.
criteria.test: approve sets Approved and ApprovedBy for an approver

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view per RQ-FXL-0006. An inactive session returns SessionExpired (isActive). Otherwise it returns the entries whose TenantId matches the session's tenant, in original order. No role, including Admin, widens this (DF-FXL-0005, which supersedes DF-FXL-0002).

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries.
criteria.test: admin sees only its own tenant's entries
view of an expired session reports SessionExpired

criteria.criterion: Returned entries keep their original order.
criteria.test: view returns only the session tenant's entries in original order

summary: Not implemented. RQ-FXL-0008 (currency conversion) has status proposed and no acceptance criteria. It depends on DF-FXL-0009 (choose an exchange-rate source), which is still a draft. The record says no rates are available to the ledger yet, and rounding and rate date are not specified. convertCurrency is left as failwith "not implemented". A decision on the rate source and the rounding/rate-date rules is needed before this can be built and tested.

criteria.criterion: Amounts convert between ISO 4217 currencies using the rate source chosen in DF-FXL-0009.
